summary: Tested the competitions reveal / two-copy publishing / void-before-reveal work on backend and frontend (375x667 web preview). Backend: tests/test_reveal_iter63.py passes 5/5 and test_draw_hardening_iter59.py passes. The new tests/test_reveal_tz_iter64.py found one critical bug: the reveal loop compared ISO strings, so a reveal_at typed in the merchant form (no timezone, read as Saudi time +03:00) was revealed 3 hours late. I fixed it in competition_reveal.py and it now passes 3/3 (24/24 across the 3 suites). UI checks that work: the Current/Past tabs; the countdown card ('Withdrawn — Announcement Coming Soon') after a hidden draw; the detail page hides winners and shows the hidden note; /api/draws/public returns 404 to customers and anonymous users; the full store draw in the studio as merchant (begin, pull, finish, then the reveal and void cards); store void with a reason (the session is marked voided and the draw can be run again); chamber draw with code 246810, the chamber requests a void (pending, no approve button for the chamber), the merchant sees approve/reject and approving voids it; the chamber portal shows the reveal note and the void request card; social competition badges open the right competition; the form fields comp-reveal-at/comp-presenter save and create a social post whose badge uses the presenter name; reveal before end returns 422 from the backend. Issues: on web the merchant form never shows the 422 error or the success message (Alert.alert does nothing on react-native-web); seeded past comps show 'شاهد إثبات السحب' but have no draw session, so no DrawProof/video appears; deleting a competition leaves its social posts behind (8 orphan TEST posts from earlier runs are in the feed); naive reveal_at is stored without +03:00, so client countdowns depend on the device timezone.

critical.issue: FIXED: compared at.isoformat() <= now().isoformat() as strings. reveal_at from the merchant form is naive (KSA, +03:00) while now() is UTC, so the string comparison revealed 3h late. Changed to datetime comparison at <= now(). Reproduced by test_loop_reveals_naive_ksa_time (failed before, passes after).

minor.issue: Does not delete the social posts linked to the competition (social_post_id/results_post_id, linked_competition_id). They become orphan feed posts whose badge opens a competition that returns 404. 8 orphan TEST_ posts exist now (created 06:24 by earlier pytest runs, e.g. ids 6af015966db98f5d484d51ce, 6af015c16db98f5d484d5208), and they show at the top of the customer Social feed. The test fixture cleanup in test_draw_hardening_iter59 has the same gap: each run leaves about 5 posts behind.

reveal_at is stored as typed ('2026-11-22T20:00', no offset). The backend reads it as KSA time, but the frontend Countdown uses new Date(naive), which uses the device's local timezone, so the countdown is wrong on devices outside UTC+3. Normalize to an explicit +03:00 offset on save (the seed already does this).
'reject' and 'cancel' have no party check: the requester can 'reject' and the other party can 'cancel'. Cosmetic only, since both just clear the request, but the audit kind can be misleading.

access-control-allow-origin '*' is returned together with allow-credentials true. Auth uses bearer tokens with no httpOnly cookie, which is acceptable for mobile. Brute-force lockout was not tested, to avoid locking the shared test accounts.

ui_bugs.issue: On web, Alert.alert does nothing in react-native-web, so the 422 error ('وقت إعلان النتائج لازم يكون بعد انتهاء المشاركة...') is never shown. After a successful create, no success message appears and router.back() never runs: the user stays on the form and may submit again. Verified: backend logs show 422 then 200, the UI shows no feedback. Use the same web notify (window.alert) helper as draw-studio.

Always shows 'شاهد إثبات السحب' even when the comp has no draw sessions. Both seeded past comps (رمضان / اليوم الوطني) have no draw_sessions and no draw_video_url, so the detail page shows no DrawProof and no video (/api/draws/public returns []). The seed should create a finished draw session (plus a demo video URL), or the card should hide the proof link. Ref: app/(tabs)/competitions.tsx:68

integration_issues.issue: Badges on orphan posts (competition deleted) open /competition/{deletedId}, which shows a spinner and then 'غير موجود'. Caused by the backend not cleaning up posts.

issues: When the status pill text is long ('Withdrawn — Announcement Coming Soon'), the mode pill 'Store Withdrawal' overflows and is clipped at the card edge (needs flexWrap).
'سحب المتجر' is auto-translated as 'Store Withdrawal', 'تم السحب' as 'Withdrawn' and 'سحب الغرفة' as 'Room Draw'. It should be 'Store draw' / 'Drawn' / 'Chamber draw'; add fixed translations.
Some labels are still Arabic in the EN UI: 'وقت إعلان النتائج (اختياري)' on the form, and the studio void card body/buttons for the merchant.
Says 'The result is final and recorded' even when the result is still hidden and can be voided before the reveal. Mention the reveal time instead.
Shows 'Open Studio to approve or reject' even when the chamber itself made the request (it can only withdraw it).

react_native_issues.issue: Alert.alert does nothing on react-native-web, so the competition form gives no feedback on the web preview. Reference: /app/frontend/app/merchant/competition-form.tsx:105-106

action_items: Keep the reveal_loop fix (datetime comparison). Optionally normalize reveal_at to a +03:00 ISO string on create/update so the client Countdown is correct in any timezone.
Delete linked social posts (by linked_competition_id) in DELETE /api/merchant/competitions/{cid} and in the test cleanup fixtures. Remove the 8 orphan TEST_ posts now in the feed.
competition-form: use a cross-platform notify (window.alert on web) for errors and success, and navigate back after success.
Seed: give past demo comps a finished draw_session (plus a demo draw_video_url) so DrawProof/video appear, or hide 'شاهد إثبات السحب' when there is no proof.
Fix the clipped mode pill on competition cards (flexWrap) and the 'Withdrawal' mistranslation of سحب.
critical_code_review_comments: competition_reveal.reveal_loop: string comparison of ISO timestamps across different offsets (fixed).
competition_reveal.party(): any 'merchant' role user counts as the merchant party. Fine for a single store, but worth checking against comp.created_by_merchant.
server.py is >6800 lines; it should be split into routers.
seed_data_creation: Re-ran seed_demo_competitions.py at the end (tag demo_mix), so the demo IDs changed. Deleted everything this run created: the TEST_ITER64 comps and their posts, plus the 5 orphan posts left by my iter59 run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Seed IDs change on every seed run, so look them up by title. Store draws need no officer code; chamber code is 246810. A 'Congratulations' modal with a 'Continue' text button appears after a pull and after finishing, and must be dismissed. ConfirmSheet buttons are draw-confirm-ok/-cancel. Python Playwright dialog handler: asyncio.ensure_future(d.accept()). The test container's Chromium shows Arabic letters disconnected because of missing system Arabic fonts; this comes from the environment, not the app.
rca_of_issue: Reveal delay: reveal_loop used at.isoformat() <= now().isoformat(). For reveal_at='2026-11-03T15:00' (KSA), _ts gives 15:00+03:00 (12:00 UTC), but the string '2026-11-03T15:00:00+03:00' is greater than '2026-11-03T12:30:...+00:00', so the loop skipped it until UTC reached 15:00, i.e. 3h late. Fix: compare datetime objects.
